description: A button of a waiting ask pressed, with its form's values: its task told (inbox_wait), and the ask out of every Inbox. A person's (a head's), or a Bot's (its answer_ask tool: as: its own session id): one of an ask sent to that Bot answers it, one of the Bot's own task's is a proposal for the person to confirm.

req.description: The request's number, the client's pick: its answers carry it back.

values.description: The form's values, by its fields' names.

as.description: A Bot answering it: its own session id.

version.description: The version (its n) it was pressed on: refused if the ask has a newer one.
